---
name: review-code-multiple-agents
description: Guide for reviewing code changes, new implementations, or planning documents.
---

How the code should be, ideally:

- Robust
- Maintainable
- Secure
- Performant
- Readable
- Well-structured
- Testable

Things to look for:

- Code correctness and logic
- Code readability and maintainability
- Adherence to coding standards and best practices
- Potential performance issues
- Security vulnerabilities
- Proper error handling and logging
- Test coverage and quality
- Documentation and comments

Things to avoid:

- Focusing on minor issues at the expense of more significant problems
- Ignoring the broader context of the code changes
- Overengineering
